rationale: The reply gives the correct fix: clean the seal, drawer and filter, run Drum Clean, use less softener, do hotter washes and leave the door open. It does this without recommending a part and only suggests an engineer if the smell persists. It asks no questions about wash temperature, softener use or the state of the seal, so it is generic and a bit long. It also does not tell the customer to unplug before opening the drain filter, and it hedges on the dryer side. The advice happens to fit this case well.
